description: This PHP file defines the Translation controller for the admin section of an OpenCart project. It manages translation listings, forms, updates, enabling/disabling, deletion, directory paths, and language-specific translation fetching within the admin interface.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing translation entries in the admin panel, including listing, editing, enabling/disabling, deleting, and fetching translation files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the main translation page and prepares data such as breadcrumbs, store and language options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to output the list of translations.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the translation list view with filtering, pagination, and associated data.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the translation creation/edit form, pre-loading existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the submission of the translation form, adding or updating translation entries.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Retrieves and returns available language file paths within the language and extension directories.

methods.name: translation
methods.description: Fetches specific translation entries from language files based on store, language, and route parameters.
